bot_quota: Total number of bots to maintain in the game.
bot_quota_mode: Defines the system for maintaining bot quota. 'fill' means the game will add bots to fill the empty player slots.
bot_difficulty: Difficulty level of bots. 0 = Easy, 1 = Normal, 2 = Hard, 3 = Expert.
bot_join_team: Determines which team bots will join.
bot_stop: Stop bot movement and processing. Useful for aim practicing.
sv_cheats: Enables cheats on server. Required for noclip, infinite ammo, god, and bot frozen toggles.
sv_infinite_ammo: Infinite ammo. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Infinite clip and reserve (no reload), 2 = Infinite reserve (requires reloading).
sv_showimpacts: Shows bullet impacts. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Red (client) and Blue (server), 2 = Red only, 3 = Blue only.
sv_grenade_trajectory: Shows a trajectory line when throwing grenades.
sv_grenade_trajectory_time: Duration in seconds to draw the grenade trajectory line.
mp_warmuptime: Length of warmup period in seconds.
mp_roundtime: Length of rounds in minutes for generic game modes.
mp_roundtime_defuse: Length of rounds in minutes for defusal-type maps.
mp_freezetime: Length of freeze time at round start in seconds.
mp_buytime: Time in seconds during which weapons can be purchased at round start.
mp_buy_anywhere: Allow buying weapons anywhere on the map, bypassing spawn-zone restrictions.
mp_startmoney: Amount of money players start with on first round or reset.
mp_maxmoney: Maximum amount of money players are allowed to accumulate.
mp_friendlyfire: Enables friendly fire, allowing players to deal damage to teammates.
mp_autoteambalance: Enables auto-team balance to prevent lopsided team counts.
mp_limitteams: Maximum number of players one team can have over another.
mp_respawn_on_death_t: Allows Terrorists to respawn instantly after dying.
mp_respawn_on_death_ct: Allows Counter-Terrorists to respawn instantly after dying.
cl_hud_color: HUD color customization. 0 = Default, 1 = White, 2 = Light Blue, 3 = Blue, 4 = Purple, 5 = Red, 6 = Orange, 7 = Yellow, 8 = Green, 9 = Aqua, 10 = Pink.
cl_radar_scale: The scale/zoom factor of the mini-map radar.
cl_radar_always_centered: If enabled, the radar map centers around the player, rather than keeping the entire map view locked.
cl_showfps: Shows the FPS counter on screen. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Simple FPS, 2 = Show Smooth/Average, 3 = Show Server details, 4 = Show details + Log.
net_graph: Enables the network graphing interface showing ping, packet loss, and FPS details.
bot_kick: Kicks all bots from the server. Write as a bind/alias helper in practice configs.
mp_roundtime_hostage: Round length in minutes for hostage maps.
mp_maxrounds: Maximum number of rounds before the match ends.
mp_overtime_enable: Enables overtime when the match is tied.
mp_free_armor: Gives free armor. 0 = off, 1 = armor, 2 = armor + helmet.
mp_death_drop_gun: Controls whether players drop their gun on death.
mp_dm_time_between_bonus_max: Maximum time between deathmatch bonus spawns.
sv_airaccelerate: Air acceleration factor used for air-strafing.
mp_restartgame: Restarts the game after N seconds when written as a one-shot command.
ammo_grenade_limit_total: Total grenades a player can carry.
cl_righthand: Shows the weapon in the right hand when enabled.
cl_radar_rotate: Rotates the radar with the player view.
mp_solid_teammates: Controls teammate collision. 0 = no collision, 1 = solid, 2 = partial.
mp_ignore_round_win_conditions: Ignores normal round win conditions (useful for aim maps).
